mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_sessions ( session_id, user_id, session_name, partner_name, success_rate, confidence_level, relationship_stage, hero_insight, total_messages, analysis_status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{sessionName}, #{partnerName}, #{successRate}, #{confidenceLevel}, #{relationshipStage}, #{heroInsight}, #{totalMessages}, 'completed', SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO favorite_messages ( message_id, session_id, message_text, confidence_percentage, analysis_reason, message_date ) VALUES ( favorite_messages_seq.NEXTVAL, #{sessionId}, #{text}, #{confidence}, #{reason}, TO_TIMESTAMP(#{messageDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') )
mapper.select: SELECT session_id as sessionId, user_id as userId, session_name as sessionName, partner_name as partnerName, success_rate as successRate, confidence_level as confidenceLevel, relationship_stage as relationshipStage, hero_insight as heroInsight, created_at as analysisDate, total_messages as totalMessages, analysis_status as analysisStatus FROM analysis_sessions WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}

SELECT /*+ INDEX(interest_trends IDX_INTEREST_SESSION_DATE) */ TO_CHAR(trend_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as date, interest_value as value, message_count as messageCount, response_time_avg as avgResponseTime, emoji_usage_count as emojiCount FROM interest_trends WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY trend_date
SELECT positive_percentage as positive, neutral_percentage as neutral, negative_percentage as negative FROM emotion_analysis WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
SELECT signal_text as text, signal_description as description, confidence_score as confidence, signal_type as type FROM positive_signals WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY confidence_score DESC

SELECT /*+ INDEX(favorite_messages IDX_FAVORITE_SESSION_CONF) */ message_text as text, confidence_percentage as confidence, analysis_reason as reason, TO_CHAR(message_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as messageDate FROM favorite_messages WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND ROWNUM = 1 ORDER BY confidence_percentage DESC

SELECT /*+ INDEX(analysis_sessions IDX_ANALYSIS_USER_CREATED) */ session_id as sessionId, session_name as sessionName, partner_name as partnerName, success_rate as successRate, confidence_level as confidenceLevel, relationship_stage as relationshipStage, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as analysisDate, total_messages as totalMessages FROM analysis_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_sessions ( session_id, user_id, session_name, partner_name, success_rate, confidence_level, relationship_stage, hero_insight, total_messages, analysis_status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{sessionName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{partnerName}, #{mainResults.successRate}, #{mainResults.confidenceLevel}, #{mainResults.relationshipStage}, #{mainResults.heroInsight}, 0, 'completed', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_sessions SET success_rate = #{mainResults.successRate}, confidence_level = #{mainResults.confidenceLevel}, relationship_stage = #{mainResults.relationshipStage}, hero_insight = #{mainResults.heroInsight}, analysis_status = 'completed' WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT session_id as sessionId, user_id as userId, session_name as sessionName, partner_name as partnerName, success_rate, confidence_level, relationship_stage, hero_insight, created_at as analysisDate, total_messages, analysis_status FROM analysis_sessions WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT session_id as sessionId, session_name as sessionName, partner_name as partnerName, success_rate as successRate, confidence_level as confidenceLevel, relationship_stage as relationshipStage, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as analysisDate, total_messages as totalMessages FROM analysis_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userEmail} ORDER BY created_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
